name: github-clone
title: GitHub clone
description: A working GitHub repository client. Signed in with GitHub in the Passwords keychain (the same passkey-encrypted device sign-in the Passwords block and the docs use), it reads and writes real repositories straight on GitHub's REST and GraphQL APIs: browse code at any branch, tag or commit; history, blame and go-to-file; edit, create and delete files; branches, tags and releases; issues and pull requests with GitHub's search syntax, filters and pages; comments, reactions, labels, assignees and milestones; compare and open pull requests; line comments, reviews and threads; a truthful merge box with every allowed method; Actions runs, jobs, re-runs and dispatch; Insights; Settings. Every control respects the account's real permissions. Without a sign-in the same code runs against a small GitHub in the page with an invented repository, so every workflow can be tried offline and nothing leaves the page. Primer colors in light and dark; a phone layout with pushed screens that reaches everything the desktop does.
